#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    int cap, flow;
    ll cost;
    Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, ll cost) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap), flow(0), cost(cost) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
int n;

// Dinic max flow (ignores cost)
bool bfs(int src, int dest, vector<int>& dist) {
    fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), -1);
    dist[src] = 0;
    vector<int> q(n);
    int qs = 0;
    q[qs++] = src;
    for (int i = 0; i < qs; i++) {
        int u = q[i];
        for (const Edge& e : graph[u]) {
            if (dist[e.to] < 0 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                dist[e.to] = dist[u] + 1;
                q[qs++] = e.to;
            }
        }
    }
    return dist[dest] >= 0;
}

ll dfs(vector<int>& ptr, vector<int>& dist, int dest, int u, ll f) {
    if (u == dest) return f;
    for (; ptr[u] < (int)graph[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
        Edge& e = graph[u][ptr[u]];
        if (dist[e.to] == dist[u] + 1 && e.flow < e.cap) {
            ll df = dfs(ptr, dist, dest, e.to, min(f, (ll)(e.cap - e.flow)));
            if (df > 0) {
                e.flow += df;
                graph[e.to][e.rev].flow -= df;
                return df;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

ll maxFlow(int src, int dest) {
    ll flow = 0;
    vector<int> dist(n);
    while (bfs(src, dest, dist)) {
        vector<int> ptr(n, 0);
        while (true) {
            ll df = dfs(ptr, dist, dest, src, LLONG_MAX);
            if (df == 0) break;
            flow += df;
        }
    }
    return flow;
}

// Min-cost flow (Bellman-Ford with queue)
void bellmanFord(int s, vector<int>& dist, vector<int>& prevNode, vector<int>& prevEdge, vector<int>& curFlow) {
    fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INT_MAX);
    dist[s] = 0;
    curFlow[s] = INT_MAX;
    vector<bool> inQ(n, false);
    vector<int> q(n);
    int qt = 0;
    q[qt++] = s;
    inQ[s] = true;
    for (int qh = 0; (qh - qt) % n != 0; qh++) {
        int u = q[qh % n];
        inQ[u] = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); i++) {
            Edge& e = graph[u][i];
            if (e.flow >= e.cap) continue;
            int v = e.to;
            ll nd = dist[u] + e.cost;
            if (dist[v] > nd) {
                dist[v] = nd;
                prevNode[v] = u;
                prevEdge[v] = i;
                curFlow[v] = min(curFlow[u], e.cap - e.flow);
                if (!inQ[v]) {
                    inQ[v] = true;
                    q[qt++ % n] = v;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pair<int, ll> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
    vector<int> dist(n);
    vector<int> curFlow(n);
    vector<int> prevEdge(n);
    vector<int> prevNode(n);
    int flow = 0;
    ll cost = 0;
    while (flow < maxf) {
        bellmanFord(s, dist, prevNode, prevEdge, curFlow);
        if (dist[t] == INT_MAX) break;
        int df = min(curFlow[t], maxf - flow);
        flow += df;
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNode[v]) {
            Edge& e = graph[prevNode[v]][prevEdge[v]];
            e.flow += df;
            graph[v][e.rev].flow -= df;
            cost += (ll)df * e.cost;
        }
    }
    return {flow, cost};
}

void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, ll cost) {
    graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, (int)graph[t].size(), cap, cost));
    graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, (int)graph[s].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    int N, M, K, C, D;
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    vector<int> pos(N, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        int p;
        cin >> p;
        pos[p - 1]++;
    }
    int T = 100;
    n = (T + 1) * N + 2;
    graph.resize(n);
    // Add edges
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (pos[i] > 0) addEdge(0, i + 1, pos[i], 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            addEdge(1 + i * N + j, 1 + (i + 1) * N + j, K, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= K; j++) {
            addEdge(1 + i * N, (T + 1) * N + 1, 1, (ll)C * i);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        a--; b--;
        for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
            ll cost = 0;
            for (int l = 1; l <= K; l++) {
                addEdge(1 + j * N + a, 1 + (j + 1) * N + b, 1, (ll)l * l * D - cost);
                addEdge(1 + j * N + b, 1 + (j + 1) * N + a, 1, (ll)l * l * D - cost);
                cost = (ll)l * l * D;
            }
        }
    }
    auto res = minCostFlow(0, (T + 1) * N + 1, K);
    cerr << res.first << endl;
    cout << res.second << endl;
    return 0;
}
